text_en: Now the Philistines gathered their armies for battle; they were gathered at Socoh, which belongs to Judah, and encamped between Socoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人调集了军队，准备作战，集合在犹大，在索苛与阿则卡之间的厄斐斯达明扎了营。

text_en: Saul and the Israelites gathered and encamped in the valley of Elah, and formed ranks against the Philistines.
text_cn: 撒乌耳和以色列人也齐集起来，在厄拉谷扎了营，摆阵准备迎击培肋舍特人。

text_en: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side, with a valley between them.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人站在这边一座山上，以色列人站在那边一座山上，中间隔着山谷。

text_en: And there came out from the camp of the Philistines a champion named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
text_cn: 从培肋舍特人阵地中走出一个挑战的人，名叫哥肋雅，是加特人，身高六肘（zhǒu）又一拃，

text_en: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.
text_cn: 头戴铜盔，身穿铠衣，铠衣的铜重五千“协刻耳”，

text_en: He had greaves of bronze on his legs and a javelin of bronze slung between his shoulders.
text_cn: 腿裹铜叶，肩插铜枪。

text_en: The shaft of his spear was like a weaver’s beam, and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron; and his shield-bearer went before him.
text_cn: 矛竿像织布机的大轴，矛头重六百“协刻耳”；有个持盾的人给他开道。

text_en: He stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel, “Why have you come out to draw up for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and are you not servants of Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.
text_cn: 他站在以色列人的阵地前，喊说：“你们为什么出来摆阵作战？我不是培肋舍特人吗？你们不是撒乌耳的奴才吗？你们挑选一人，下来同我对敌！

text_en: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then we will be your servants; but if I prevail against him and kill him, then you shall be our servants and serve us. ”
text_cn: 假使他能同我决斗，杀了我，我们就作你们的奴隶；但是，如果我得胜，杀了他，你们就应服事我们，作我们的奴隶。”

text_en: And the Philistine said, “Today I defy the ranks of Israel! Give me a man, that we may fight together. ”
text_cn: 那培肋舍特人还说：“今天我向以色列骂阵，你们给我派个人来，让我们彼此决斗。”

text_en: When Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid.
text_cn: 撒乌耳和全以色列听见那培肋舍特人说的这些话，都十分惊慌害怕。

text_en: Now David was the son of an Ephrathite of Bethlehem in Judah, named Jesse, who had eight sons. In the days of Saul the man was already old and advanced in years.
text_cn: 达味是犹达白冷的一个厄弗辣大人的儿子，那人名叫叶瑟，他有八个儿子。此人在撒乌耳时，已经老了。

text_en: The three eldest sons of Jesse had followed Saul to the battle; the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
text_cn: 叶瑟的三个大儿已跟撒乌耳出征作战；从军的三个儿子：长子名叫厄里雅布，次子名叫阿彼纳达布，三子名叫沙玛。

text_en: David was the youngest; the three eldest followed Saul,
text_cn: 达味最小，三个年长的已跟撒乌耳出征。

text_en: but David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.
text_cn: 达味有时服侍撒乌耳，有时离开，回白冷放他父亲的羊。

text_en: For forty days the Philistine came forward and took his stand, morning and evening.
text_cn: 那培肋舍特人早晨晚上常出来挑战，一连四十天之久。

text_en: Jesse said to his son David, “Take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers;
text_cn: 叶瑟对他的儿子达味说：“你给你哥哥们带去这一‘厄法’炒麦和十个饼，快往营里给你哥哥们送去。

text_en: also take these ten cheeses to the commander of their thousand. See how your brothers fare, and bring some token from them. ”
text_cn: 将这十块奶饼送给千夫长；然后看望你的哥哥们是否平安，并把他们的薪俸带回来。

text_en: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
text_cn: 他们与撒乌耳和全以色列人都在厄拉谷，同培肋舍特人作战。”

text_en: David rose early in the morning, left the sheep with a keeper, took the provisions, and went as Jesse had commanded him. He came to the encampment as the army was going forth to the battle line, shouting the war cry.
text_cn: 达味清早起来，把羊群托给一个看羊的人，就照他父亲叶瑟吩咐的起身去了；他来到营中时，军队正出来摆阵，喊着冲锋的口号。

text_en: Israel and the Philistines drew up for battle, army against army.
text_cn: 以色列人和培肋舍特人列阵相对。

text_en: David left the things in charge of the keeper of the baggage, ran to the ranks, and went and greeted his brothers.
text_cn: 达味把自己的行囊交在一个看守辎重兵的手内，跑入阵内，向他的哥哥们问安。

text_en: As he talked with them, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and spoke the same words as before. And David heard him.
text_cn: 当他和他们谈话时，名叫哥肋雅的挑战者，──加特的培肋舍特人──从培肋舍特人的阵里上来，说了以上所述的话，达味也听见了。

text_en: All the Israelites, when they saw the man, fled from him and were very much afraid.
text_cn: 所有的以色列人一看见那人，都十分害怕，便由他面前逃避了。

text_en: The Israelites said, “Have you seen this man who has come up? Surely he has come up to defy Israel. The king will greatly enrich the man who kills him, and will give him his daughter and make his family free in Israel. ”
text_cn: 那时，有个以色列人宣布说：“你们看见了上来的这人吗？这人上来是辱骂以色列。若有人把他杀死，君王要赐给他很多的财富，将自己的女儿嫁给他为妻，并使他的父家在以色列内豁免缴税。”

text_en: David said to the men who stood by him, “What shall be done for the man who kills this Philistine, and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine that he should defy the armies of the living God? ”
text_cn: 达味问站在他旁边的人说：“杀死这培肋舍特人，给以色列雪耻的人得什么赏？这未受割损的培肋舍特人是谁？他竟敢辱骂永生天主的军旅！”

text_en: The people answered him in the same way, “So shall it be done for the man who kills him. ”
text_cn: 人就把上边那些话告诉他说：“杀死这人的，要得这样这样的报酬。”

text_en: His eldest brother Eliab heard him talking to the men; and Eliab’s anger was kindled against David. He said, “Why have you come down? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your presumption and the evil of your heart; for you have come down just to see the battle. ”
text_cn: 他的大哥厄里雅布一听见达味对那些人所说的话，便对达味大发忿怒说：“你为什么下来？你在旷野中放的那几只羊，托给了谁？我知道你骄傲，心中不怀好意；你下来只是要观看作战。”

text_en: David said, “What have I done now? It was only a question. ”
text_cn: 达味回答说：“我究竟作的什么不对？连句话也不能说吗？”

text_en: He turned away from him toward another and spoke in the same way; and the people answered him again as before.
text_cn: 达味就离开那里，到了另一处，又问了同样的事，人回答的话也和先前一样。

text_en: When the words that David spoke were heard, they repeated them before Saul; and he sent for him.
text_cn: 有人听见了达味说的话，就去报告给撒乌耳，撒乌耳就命他前来。

text_en: David said to Saul, “Let no one’s heart fail because of him; your servant will go and fight with this Philistine. ”
text_cn: 达味对撒乌耳说：“请我主心中不必为那人而沮丧，你仆人要去同这培肋舍特人决斗。”

text_en: Saul said to David, “You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for you are just a boy, and he has been a warrior from his youth. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳对达味说：“你不能去对抗这培肋舍特人，同他决斗，因为你还年轻，而他自幼即是习于战斗的人。”

text_en: But David said to Saul, “Your servant used to keep sheep for his father; and whenever a lion or a bear came, and took a lamb from the flock,
text_cn: 达味回答撒乌耳说：“你的仆人是为他父亲牧羊的人，几时有狮子或狗熊闯来，由羊群中夺去一只羊，

text_en: I went after it and struck it down, rescuing the lamb from its mouth; and if it turned against me, I would catch it by the jaw, strike it down, and kill it.
text_cn: 我就追上去，打死它，从它口中救出那只羊来；假使狮子起来扑我，我就抓住它的须，将它打死。

text_en: Your servant has killed both lions and bears; and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be like one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God. ”
text_cn: 你的仆人连狮子带狗熊都打死了，这未受割损的培肋舍特人也不过像其中的一个，因为他竟敢辱骂永生天主的军旅！”

text_en: David said, “The Lord , who saved me from the paw of the lion and from the paw of the bear, will save me from the hand of this Philistine. ” So Saul said to David, “Go, and may the Lord be with you! ”
text_cn: 达味又接着说：“由狮子和狗熊的爪牙中拯救我的上主，也必从这培肋舍特人的手中拯救我。”撒乌耳对达味说：“去吧！望上主与你同在！”

text_en: Saul clothed David with his armor; he put a bronze helmet on his head and clothed him with a coat of mail.
text_cn: 撒乌耳给达味穿上自己的武装，给他头上戴上铜盔，身上穿上铠甲，

text_en: David strapped Saul’s sword over the armor, and he tried in vain to walk, for he was not used to them. Then David said to Saul, “I cannot walk with these; for I am not used to them. ” So David removed them.
text_cn: 又在铠甲上给达味佩上了自己的刀。达味试走了两步，因他没有穿惯，遂对撒乌耳说：“穿戴这些东西，我不能行动，因为我先前总没有穿过。”所以他又将这些盔甲从身上脱下。

text_en: Then he took his staff in his hand, and chose five smooth stones from the wadi, and put them in his shepherd’s bag, in the pouch; his sling was in his hand, and he drew near to the Philistine.
text_cn: 达味手里拿着自己的棍子，在河里拣了五块很光滑的石头，放在牧童随身所带的袋子内，即装石囊内，手内拿着投石器，向那培肋舍特人走去。

text_en: The Philistine came on and drew near to David, with his shield-bearer in front of him.
text_cn: 那培肋舍特人也大摇大摆走近了达味，给他持盾的在前给他开路。

text_en: When the Philistine looked and saw David, he disdained him, for he was only a youth, ruddy and handsome in appearance.
text_cn: 那培肋舍特人瞪眼一看，见了达味，遂看不起他，因达味还很年轻，面色红润，眉清目秀。

text_en: The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks? ” And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
text_cn: 那培肋舍特人对达味说：“莫非我是只狗，你竟拿棍子来对付我？”达味回答说：“你比一只狗还不如！”那培肋舍特人就指着自己的神诅咒达味，

text_en: The Philistine said to David, “Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and to the wild animals of the field. ”
text_cn: 且对达味说：“你到我这里来，我要把你的肉，给空中的飞鸟和田野的走兽吃。”

text_en: But David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with sword and spear and javelin; but I come to you in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
text_cn: 达味回答那培肋舍特人说：“你仗着刀枪箭戟来对付我，但我是仗着你所凌辱的万军的上主，以色列军旅的天主的圣名来对付你。

text_en: This very day the Lord will deliver you into my hand, and I will strike you down and cut off your head; and I will give the dead bodies of the Philistine army this very day to the birds of the air and to the wild animals of the earth, so that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,
text_cn: 今天上主定把你交在我手中，我必打死你，割下你的头来；今天我要把你的尸体和培肋舍特军人的尸体，给空中的飞鸟和田野间的走兽吃：这样，全地要知道在以色列有天主。

text_en: and that all this assembly may know that the Lord does not save by sword and spear; for the battle is the Lord ’s and he will give you into our hand. ”
text_cn: 在场的众人也要知道：上主不赖刀枪赐人胜利，战争胜负只属于上主，他已把你们交在我们手中了。”

text_en: When the Philistine drew nearer to meet David, David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet the Philistine.
text_cn: 正当那培肋舍特人起身，大摇大摆向达味走来时，达味赶快由阵地跑出来，迎那培肋舍特人；

text_en: David put his hand in his bag, took out a stone, slung it, and struck the Philistine on his forehead; the stone sank into his forehead, and he fell face down on the ground.
text_cn: 同时伸手，由囊中取出一块石头，套在投石器上打过去，正打在那培肋舍特人的额上，石头穿入额内，那人就跌倒在地上。

text_en: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone, striking down the Philistine and killing him; there was no sword in David’s hand.
text_cn: 如此，达味用投石器和石头，得胜了那培肋舍特人，打中了他，将他杀死，虽然手无寸铁。

text_en: Then David ran and stood over the Philistine; he grasped his sword, drew it out of its sheath, and killed him; then he cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.
text_cn: 达味遂跑过去，站在那培肋舍特人身上，拿起他的刀，从鞘内拔出，杀了他，砍下了他的头。所有培肋舍特人看见他们的英雄死了，就四散奔逃。

text_en: The troops of Israel and Judah rose up with a shout and pursued the Philistines as far as Gath and the gates of Ekron, so that the wounded Philistines fell on the way from Shaaraim as far as Gath and Ekron.
text_cn: 以色列和犹大人遂起来呐喊，追击培肋舍特人直到加特关，直到厄刻龙城门。沿沙阿辣因的路上，直到加特和厄刻龙，遍地是培肋舍特人的尸首。

text_en: The Israelites came back from chasing the Philistines, and they plundered their camp.
text_cn: 以色列人追杀培肋舍特人回来，又抢劫了他们的营幕。

text_en: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armor in his tent.
text_cn: 以后，达味取了那培肋舍特人的头，送到耶路撒冷；至于那人的武器，却放在会幕内。

text_en: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the commander of the army, “Abner, whose son is this young man? ” Abner said, “As your soul lives, O king, I do not know. ”
text_cn: 当撒乌耳看见达味去和那培肋舍特人迎战时，就问统帅阿贝乃尔说：“阿贝乃尔，这少年人是谁的儿子？”阿贝乃尔回答说：“大王万岁，我不知道。”

text_en: The king said, “Inquire whose son the stripling is. ”
text_cn: 君王说：“你查一下，这少年人是谁的儿子？”

text_en: On David’s return from killing the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul, with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
text_cn: 达味杀死那培肋舍特人回来时，阿贝乃尔带他去见撒乌耳，他手中还拿着那培肋舍特人的头。

text_en: Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, young man? ” And David answered, “I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳问他说：“少年人你是谁的儿子？”达味答说：“我是你仆白冷人叶瑟的儿子。”
